# Python environment for the bulk tAge pipeline (bulk_RNA_seq/.venv).
# Exact versions of the environment that produced rerun_outputs/ (Linux, Python 3.12.3,
# 2026-09). The same interpreter is used by R through reticulate (R/config.R PYTHON_BIN).
#
# The three tAge .pkl models were pickled with scikit-learn 1.3.2. Loading them in 1.9.0
# raises InconsistentVersionWarning; the tAge package patches SimpleImputer for this
# (tAge/python/tage_predict.py, _patch_simple_imputer). Keep scikit-learn at the version
# below when regenerating outputs, so that re-runs compare like with like.
joblib==1.6.0
numpy==2.5.3
pandas==3.0.5
python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0
scikit-learn==1.9.0
scipy==1.18.1
six==1.17.0
threadpoolctl==3.6.0
